answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities: each agent burns 50 coins to claim one single-use work slot per epoch. A public atlas lists every claimed slot, so mirror filings copying one operator show up at once. An honest agent pays 50 coins once, keeps its voyage record intact, and earns undiluted rewards. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 coins, burned with no refund, while honest work recovers the fee in about 30 days.
